اختفيا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَفَيَا (iḵtafayā) /ix.ta.fa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# اُخْتُفِيَا (uḵtufiyā) /ux.tu.fi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# اِخْتَفِيَا (iḵtafiyā) /ix.ta.fi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
